svg.title: The evolution of software worlds
svg.desc: Three click-controlled eras: one monolith planet with concentric domain sectors and linked modules, several smaller service planets, then volcanic growth and unexpected new services.
svg.text: A BRIEF HISTORY OF SOFTWARE WORLDS

g.text: In the beginning, there was the monolith.
One deployment. An entire world of dependencies.
Smaller worlds. Simpler interiors. More connections.
Worlds grow. New ones appear. Pressure builds.
